propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective emits false-positive warnings when input_tokens is below the 4096-token cache floor, because the zero/zero counter state is expected and correct for uncacheable prompts
the warning fires on every small call in a gate run (~20 per review-plan), creating alarm fatigue that masks the real signal when caching genuinely fails

the observed sub-floor input values (1822, 2184, 2317, 3140 tokens) all triggered warnings despite being below the documented floor, while the same run's aggregate cache metrics proved caching worked elsewhere
the fix gates the warning on input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096), eliminating false positives below the floor while preserving detection above it
CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS must be defined once in a shared module (capabilities.py) rather than duplicated between pass1.py and structured_run.py to enforce the invariant
